database.title: Listmonk
database.blurb: The schema behind listmonk, a self-hosted newsletter and mailing-list manager: subscribers and the lists they belong to, campaigns and their deliveries, media, bounces, and the users and roles that run it.

domains.title: Audience
domains.blurb: Subscribers, lists, the subscription rows that join them with a status, and the bounces recorded against a subscriber.

domains.title: Campaigns
domains.blurb: Campaigns, the lists they target, the templates they render with, and the views and link clicks they earn.

domains.title: Media
domains.blurb: Uploaded files and which campaigns embed them.

domains.title: Users and roles
domains.blurb: Admin users, the roles that scope what they can do (including per-list roles), and their sessions.

conventions: Primary keys are SERIAL integers; public identifiers are separate UUID columns.
Timestamps are TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE.
